_comment: Stage 0 inputs. Every number carries a source and a status. Fractions are of a node's nominal GPU power, matching lever-curves-v0.2 units. 'estimated' means read off a paper's figure or derived; nothing here is Jade-measured except where noted.

static_frac.source: Jade v0.2 parked_frac (43 W / 250 W, A100)

cap_floor_frac.source: Jade v0.2 gpu_power_cap note: settable floor 150 W of 250 W

decode_latency_vs_clock.form: TPOT flat until r_knee, then ~ r_knee/r (memory-bound)
decode_latency_vs_clock.source: PowerSlider Fig. on decode insensitivity; knee value is our read of the figure

remove_depth_frac.source: Jade v0.2 drain_to_parked per pool; mono = measured busy 0.84 - parked 0.17

remove_latency_cap.source: Yan et al. arXiv:2609.24639: median TTFT 0.7 s -> 8.5 s on decode-instance removal (~12x)

tier_weights.source: flex is pre-consented deferral (Decision 5); weight is a design choice, swept in the script
